description:
OBJECTIVE: Stop the recurring CHANGELOG.md merge conflicts by moving unreleased entries out of the shared [Unreleased] region into one JSON file per PR under changelog.d/. This item builds only the inert library; later items wire it into release prep (changelog-fragments-02), cut over (03), update the skill (04) and verify end to end (05).

WHY NOT A SHARED changelog.jsonl (reframe, decided from evidence): any single file that every PR appends to conflicts on GitHub for every pair of overlapping PRs, and merge=union does not help because GitHub's server-side merge does not run the union driver (reproduced; #3261 is CONFLICTING now; docs/internal/release-guide.md ~220-222 already says so). Measured: 145 PRs touched CHANGELOG.md in 60 days, 61% overlapped another such PR, ~33% would text-conflict; #3181 needed a 3-region hand merge after #3189. One file per PR cannot conflict. PR-body/trailer extraction was rejected (reverts leave entries live; source of truth outside git).

PRIOR ART: extends scripts/generate_changelog_entry.py and scripts/release_flow.py (section tooling, curation gate); path manifests use _project/scripts/soundness_paths._load_rules (same parser as inert_paths.py). Supersedes the union rule (.gitattributes) in item 03. Build in-house; do not add towncrier/scriv (dependency-bounds policy; they cannot fold rc sections, maintain compare links or render BREAKING leads).

DELIVERABLE: scripts/changelog_fragments.py (+ tests) with subcommands check, add, preview, required; Makefile targets changelog-entry, changelog-preview, changelog-check (+ help.mk lines, makefile inventory); a property-ledger row for the new script (tests/unit/test_ledger_coverage.py requires one for every script).

SCHEMA (changelog.d/<branch-slug>.json, slug = branch with / -> -):
  {"schema":1,"entries":[{"category":"before-you-upgrade|added|changed|fixed|documentation","breaking":bool,"lead":str,"text":str,"details":[str],"platforms":[id],"benchmarks":[id]}]}
  or {"schema":1,"internal":"<10-300 chars>"} for a change with no user-visible effect.
  Rules: exactly one of entries (1-5) or internal; unknown keys rejected; file name ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,99}\.json$; breaking:true requires category before-you-upgrade and a lead and renders '- **BREAKING: <lead>.** <text>'; text = one Markdown paragraph 20-800 chars, no newline, no leading '- ', no trailing '(#NNNN)'; details <=8 items rendered as nested bullets; platforms/benchmarks optional lowercase ids (format-checked; prep warns on unknown ids). The PR number is NEVER written in the file: it is derived at release time from the squash subject of the commit that added the file (git log --diff-filter=A --format=%s -- <file>, parse '(#N)') and appears only in the curation worksheet. Internal-only files render nothing.
  Render order: Before you upgrade, Added, Changed, Fixed, Documentation; within a heading sort by platform/benchmark tag.

REQUIRED-ENTRY DECISION (function + CLI, not yet wired to CI): inputs = PR title (via argument, never shell-interpolated), changed-paths list, changed files under changelog.d/ vs base, release-identity-changed flag. NOT required when title type is build, chore (except chore(deps)), ci, docs, refactor, style, test; title starts with 'Revert "'; release identity changed (prep PR); or no changed path matches .github/changelog-paths.txt (manifest format below, created in item 03; here the function takes the rules as a parameter and tests use fixtures). Required for feat, fix, perf, any '!' title, chore(deps), and non-conventional titles (fail closed). Satisfied by any add, modify or delete under changelog.d/*.json (a delete covers reverts). Internal-typed PR adding a user entry = non-blocking warning. Manifest rules: prefix benchbox/, _sources/, _binaries/; file pyproject.toml, MANIFEST.in; except benchbox/utils/VERSION_MANAGEMENT.md.

UNRELEASED GUARD (function): the text between '## [Unreleased]' and the next '## [' must be blank; judged on file state, not diff.

DECISION GATES (all must hold before opening the PR):
  G1 Re-verify every cited path/symbol/line against the live tree (rg); line numbers in this plan are not durable. Record discrepancies in context.
  G2 Base is current origin/develop; develop trunk is not red for a reason related to this change.
  G3 Inertness: the diff creates no changelog.d/ directory, no CI/workflow edit, no AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/skill edit, no change to CHANGELOG.md, scripts/generate_changelog_entry.py, scripts/release_flow.py, release*.yml or release Makefile targets other than adding the three new targets.

GUARDRAILS: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create ... && make agent-write-preflight), never the primary clone; follow AGENTS.md (uv run --, no explanatory comments/docstrings per COMMENT-POLICY-001, run make comment-policy-check, 120 cols, Ruff); do not touch the curated [0.5.0rc1] section; stage explicit paths, never git add -A; no agent attribution trailers; durable commit/PR text with no process labels; run make pr-preflight once then make pr-open; soundness-path files need oracle review: resolve every thread, arm (make pr-arm PR=N) only on a success review of the current head, then monitor to merge. No tag, ruleset, branch or label operations.
